name: Hygiene Debris
definition: A change leaves behind artifacts that no longer contribute to the delivered system. Membership test: nothing in the delivered system depends on the artifact.

name: Annotation Noise
definition: Prose in the source adds no information that the code does not already carry. Membership test: the comment states nothing that the code cannot.

name: Redundant Guarding
definition: A runtime check or fallback duplicates a guarantee that something else already provides. Membership test: the repeated guarantee is visible and reliable at that point in the code.

name: Structural and Abstraction Slop
definition: Organization adds cost and provides no boundary, no variation point, and no reduction in complexity. Membership test: the system that exists does not use the boundary or variation that the structure provides.

name: Duplication
definition: A change adds a second implementation of something the repository already provides. Membership test: the two implementations encode one concept that must change together.

name: Test Slop
definition: A test produces a success signal without evidence about behavior. Membership test: the test cannot distinguish a correct behavior from a relevant incorrect one.

name: Integrity / Fake-Done
definition: The code or its report presents work as finished that was not done. Membership test: the artifact misrepresents completion.

name: Error-Swallowing
definition: Code suppresses, obscures, or silently converts a failure. Membership test: the caller can no longer distinguish failure from success.

name: Type Laxity
definition: An escape hatch lets code compile while weakening what the type system guarantees. Membership test: the reason for the escape is not visible or its scope is not contained.

name: Kinetic Slop
definition: A change modifies code beyond what the task requested, even when the extra change improves that code. Membership test: the modified region does not trace to the request.

name: Lexical / Naming Slop
definition: Vocabulary obscures domain meaning or departs from the terms the project already uses. Membership test: the name does not match what the repository calls the concept.
